items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was Lana Turner’s old girl. ... I was her maid or something or other.

ctx.x: Okay, because I haven’t seen that movie, like you said. I haven’t seen it in a long time. So I’ve forgotten. It was Lana Turner, and I forget the name of . . .
I was Lana Turner’s old girl.
You don’t remember how you got it. That was one of the main things that I wanted to find out.
